node.label: Environment & Ecology
node.summary: Pollution, climate, wildlife, dams and environmental law.

facts.text: CREA estimated pollution deaths rose to **5,310** in September. Singapore invoked its **Transboundary Haze Pollution Act**.
facts.plain: CREA estimated pollution deaths rose to 5,310 in September. Singapore invoked its Transboundary Haze Pollution Act.

facts.text: Indonesia's wildfires burned **1.9 million hectares** (Jan-Sep 2026), mostly peatland, worsened by **El Nino** and the **Indian Ocean Dipole**.
facts.plain: Indonesia's wildfires burned 1.9 million hectares (Jan-Sep 2026), mostly peatland, worsened by El Nino and the Indian Ocean Dipole.

facts.text: Kuno National Park (MP): a task force found cheetah cub **KNG22** was shot by recreational hunters, not wildlife traders.
facts.plain: Kuno National Park (MP): a task force found cheetah cub KNG22 was shot by recreational hunters, not wildlife traders.

facts.text: Editorial: national need doesn't excuse bypassing laws and local consent. Most of the Brahmaputra's flow comes from monsoon rain and downstream tributaries, not Tibet.
facts.plain: Editorial: national need doesn't excuse bypassing laws and local consent. Most of the Brahmaputra's flow comes from monsoon rain and downstream tributaries, not Tibet.

facts.text: A 36-hour bandh shut Upper Siang district against the project; the local **Adi** community fears losing land. Protests also target the **Subansiri Upper** project.
facts.plain: A 36-hour bandh shut Upper Siang district against the project; the local Adi community fears losing land. Protests also target the Subansiri Upper project.

facts.text: **Siang Upper Multipurpose Project** (Arunachal Pradesh), planned at **11.2 GW**, is India's answer to China's **60 GW** dam on the **Yarlung Tsangpo**, which becomes the **Brahmaputra** in India.
facts.plain: Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (Arunachal Pradesh), planned at 11.2 GW, is India's answer to China's 60 GW dam on the Yarlung Tsangpo, which becomes the Brahmaputra in India.

facts.text: Indian courts and the NGT apply both principles, as in regulating firecrackers.
facts.plain: Indian courts and the NGT apply both principles, as in regulating firecrackers.

facts.text: **Stockholm Declaration (1972)** linked human well-being to the environment; the **Rio Declaration (1992)** set the **precautionary** and **polluter-pays** principles.
facts.plain: Stockholm Declaration (1972) linked human well-being to the environment; the Rio Declaration (1992) set the precautionary and polluter-pays principles.

facts.text: Abroad: Singapore bans private crackers; the UK and Ireland restrict sales to the public; Germany and Sweden require permits.
facts.plain: Abroad: Singapore bans private crackers; the UK and Ireland restrict sales to the public; Germany and Sweden require permits.

facts.text: SC said the State had 'utterly failed' to enforce its fireworks orders since 2015, and even the complete ban had not improved air quality.
facts.plain: SC said the State had 'utterly failed' to enforce its fireworks orders since 2015, and even the complete ban had not improved air quality.

facts.text: North Delhi police seized over **1,200 kg** of crackers and filed 10 cases under the **Explosives Act**; banned crackers were sold under the counter in Sadar Bazar.
facts.plain: North Delhi police seized over 1,200 kg of crackers and filed 10 cases under the Explosives Act; banned crackers were sold under the counter in Sadar Bazar.

facts.text: Only **CSIR-NEERI / PESO** certified makers may produce (2-6 Nov); boxes need **QR codes**; no series crackers ('ladis') or garlands; sales allowed 4-6 Nov.
facts.plain: Only CSIR-NEERI / PESO certified makers may produce (2-6 Nov); boxes need QR codes; no series crackers ('ladis') or garlands; sales allowed 4-6 Nov.

facts.text: No crackers within **300 m** of hospitals, old age homes, schools and silence zones ('no-cracker zones').
facts.plain: No crackers within 300 m of hospitals, old age homes, schools and silence zones ('no-cracker zones').

facts.text: SC allowed **certified green crackers** in Delhi-NCR only on **7 and 8 Nov**, 6-7 a.m. and 8-10 p.m. Bench: Justices **M.M. Sundresh** and **Prasanna B. Varale**.
facts.plain: SC allowed certified green crackers in Delhi-NCR only on 7 and 8 Nov, 6-7 a.m. and 8-10 p.m. Bench: Justices M.M. Sundresh and Prasanna B. Varale.

facts.text: GRAP is reactive. Lasting fixes need year-round controls on vehicles, dust, industry and crop-residue burning across the airshed.
facts.plain: GRAP is reactive. Lasting fixes need year-round controls on vehicles, dust, industry and crop-residue burning across the airshed.

facts.text: Outside vehicles below **BS-VI** are barred from Delhi until **31 Jan**; on day two, 1,228 of 8,263 checked vehicles were turned back.
facts.plain: Outside vehicles below BS-VI are barred from Delhi until 31 Jan; on day two, 1,228 of 8,263 checked vehicles were turned back.

facts.text: **GRAP** (Graded Response Action Plan) has **four stages** of emergency measures and is run by the **Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)**.
facts.plain: GRAP (Graded Response Action Plan) has four stages of emergency measures and is run by the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM).

facts.text: CAQM invoked **GRAP Stage 2** as Delhi's AQI hit **324** ('very poor'): higher parking fees, staggered office hours, extra Metro trips.
facts.plain: CAQM invoked GRAP Stage 2 as Delhi's AQI hit 324 ('very poor'): higher parking fees, staggered office hours, extra Metro trips.

facts.text: Delhi's winter entry curbs on non-BS-VI, non-Delhi-registered vehicles began Sunday and run till 31 January; on Day 1, police checked 7,279 vehicles, turned back 714 non-destined vehicles and impounded 38 end-of-life vehicles.
facts.plain: Delhi's winter entry curbs on non-BS-VI, non-Delhi-registered vehicles began Sunday and run till 31 January; on Day 1, police checked 7,279 vehicles, turned back 714 non-destined vehicles and impounded 38 end-of-life vehicles.

facts.text: *The Ghost of the Mountains* by snow leopard researcher **Kulbhushansingh Suryawanshi**; the **IUCN** moved the snow leopard from **Endangered to Vulnerable** in **2017**.
facts.plain: The Ghost of the Mountains by snow leopard researcher Kulbhushansingh Suryawanshi; the IUCN moved the snow leopard from Endangered to Vulnerable in 2017.

facts.text: Two men were arrested under the **Arms Act** and six forest staff suspended over the killing of a male cheetah cub at **Kuno National Park** (M.P.).
facts.plain: Two men were arrested under the Arms Act and six forest staff suspended over the killing of a male cheetah cub at Kuno National Park (M.P.).

facts.text: Punjab farm fires nearly doubled in a week to **1,007** (194 in one day on 29 Oct); **Tarn Taran** (397), **Amritsar** (171) and **Ferozepur** (104) lead; 246 FIRs registered and ₹17 lakh in fines imposed.
facts.plain: Punjab farm fires nearly doubled in a week to 1,007 (194 in one day on 29 Oct); Tarn Taran (397), Amritsar (171) and Ferozepur (104) lead; 246 FIRs registered and ₹17 lakh in fines imposed.

facts.text: CAQM's new **Integrated Command and Control Centre** links data from **111 CAAQMS** monitoring stations, 2,300+ industries and 3,200+ construction sites in Delhi-NCR.
facts.plain: CAQM's new Integrated Command and Control Centre links data from 111 CAAQMS monitoring stations, 2,300+ industries and 3,200+ construction sites in Delhi-NCR.

facts.text: CAQM banned **construction and demolition** in Delhi-NCR from **5 to 20 Nov** (exempting railways, metro, airports, ISBTs, hospitals, defence) and ordered **50% work from home** for offices in Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Sonipat, Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar; Union Environment Minister **Bhupender Yadav** announced it. Deepavali falls on **8 Nov**.
facts.plain: CAQM banned construction and demolition in Delhi-NCR from 5 to 20 Nov (exempting railways, metro, airports, ISBTs, hospitals, defence) and ordered 50% work from home for offices in Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Sonipat, Ghaziabad and Gautam Buddha Nagar; Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav announced it. Deepavali falls on 8 Nov.

facts.text: A tigress (**BTRTF-1/T-138**) moved from Bihar to West Bengal's **Buxa Tiger Reserve** on 2 Oct crossed the **Sankosh** river into Assam's **Raimona National Park**; NTCA is tracking it by radio collar. Buxa became a tiger reserve in **1983** but had no resident tigers for years.
facts.plain: A tigress (BTRTF-1/T-138) moved from Bihar to West Bengal's Buxa Tiger Reserve on 2 Oct crossed the Sankosh river into Assam's Raimona National Park; NTCA is tracking it by radio collar. Buxa became a tiger reserve in 1983 but had no resident tigers for years.

facts.text: Toxic foam on the **Noyyal river** in **Tiruppur** (Tamil Nadu) is blamed on untreated effluents from dyeing and textile units.
facts.plain: Toxic foam on the Noyyal river in Tiruppur (Tamil Nadu) is blamed on untreated effluents from dyeing and textile units.

facts.text: Eight panchayats in **Kasaragod** (Keralam) will revive **surangams**, traditional horizontal water tunnels dug into **laterite** hills, using workers under the **VB-G RAM G** rural jobs scheme.
facts.plain: Eight panchayats in Kasaragod (Keralam) will revive surangams, traditional horizontal water tunnels dug into laterite hills, using workers under the VB-G RAM G rural jobs scheme.

facts.text: West Bengal cracker rules: decibel limit **125 dB** for sound-emitting and **90 dB** for light-emitting crackers; only green crackers; bursting allowed **8-10 p.m.** on Deepavali and **6-8 a.m.** on Chhath; sky lanterns need fire department permission. DGP: **Siddhi Nath Gupta**.
facts.plain: West Bengal cracker rules: decibel limit 125 dB for sound-emitting and 90 dB for light-emitting crackers; only green crackers; bursting allowed 8-10 p.m. on Deepavali and 6-8 a.m. on Chhath; sky lanterns need fire department permission. DGP: Siddhi Nath Gupta.

facts.text: Delhi, U.P., Haryana, Rajasthan and Punjab have implemented only **40-60%** of the anti-pollution annual action plans they filed with the **CAQM**; **Rajasthan** was the worst performer and **U.P.** the best. Punjab's plan covers only stubble burning. Delhi's AQI was 229 ('poor').
facts.plain: Delhi, U.P., Haryana, Rajasthan and Punjab have implemented only 40-60% of the anti-pollution annual action plans they filed with the CAQM; Rajasthan was the worst performer and U.P. the best. Punjab's plan covers only stubble burning. Delhi's AQI was 229 ('poor').

facts.text: BJP MP **Manoj Tiwari** took a dip in the **Yamuna** before **Chhath Puja**, claiming its pollution load had halved in a year under the Rekha Gupta government; AAP disputed it.
facts.plain: BJP MP Manoj Tiwari took a dip in the Yamuna before Chhath Puja, claiming its pollution load had halved in a year under the Rekha Gupta government; AAP disputed it.

facts.text: Protests also hit the **1,605-MW Subansiri Upper Hydroelectric Project** (also called **Menga Dam**) in Upper Subansiri district, with violence in its HQ **Daporijo** during a 12-hour shutdown.
facts.plain: Protests also hit the 1,605-MW Subansiri Upper Hydroelectric Project (also called Menga Dam) in Upper Subansiri district, with violence in its HQ Daporijo during a 12-hour shutdown.

facts.text: A rally in **Itanagar** demanded release of 30+ people detained after violent protests on 23-24 Oct against the **11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project**; mobs had burnt an **NHPC** office. The Siang meets the **Dibang** and **Lohit** to form the **Brahmaputra** in Assam.
facts.plain: A rally in Itanagar demanded release of 30+ people detained after violent protests on 23-24 Oct against the 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project; mobs had burnt an NHPC office. The Siang meets the Dibang and Lohit to form the Brahmaputra in Assam.

facts.text: SC Bench of Justices **M.M. Sundresh** and **P.B. Varale** said its cracker orders are breached 'left and right' every Deepavali but it does not favour a complete ban; it suggested using celebrities like **Virat Kohli** for awareness. In Oct 2025 it had allowed green crackers in Delhi-NCR with conditions.
facts.plain: SC Bench of Justices M.M. Sundresh and P.B. Varale said its cracker orders are breached 'left and right' every Deepavali but it does not favour a complete ban; it suggested using celebrities like Virat Kohli for awareness. In Oct 2025 it had allowed green crackers in Delhi-NCR with conditions.
